campaign: R72b - high-power targeted retest of L1 c1 p95 non-inferiority for the R72 deferred-session-close default flip
rule: Nothing in this file may be changed after data is seen. The criteria win over the measurements. No post-hoc threshold, aggregation or eligibility change. No code, test or criterion change followed by a retest.

lineage.r72_single_failed_criterion: C4 L1 c1 merged p95 B/A = 1.17471 > 1.10, with round ratios 1.26545 and 0.83121 and a bootstrap interval of roughly 0.81-1.27; treated as a frozen-rule FAIL but not as a proven stable regression
lineage.purpose: increase statistical power for the same L1 list-20 c1 scenario and the same A/B treatment; this campaign does not re-open any other R72 criterion

candidate.change_scope: PERI_DEFERRED_SESSION_CLOSE default enabled when unset; explicit 0 remains the synchronous-close fallback. Mechanism code otherwise identical to the R71 merged version.

environment.platform_build_if_rebuilt: cd prototypes/v1/platform && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o /tmp/peri-r72-ab/bin/peri-platform-r72 ./cmd/peri-platform
environment.platform_rebuild_rule: reuse the R72 build product; if a rebuild is unavoidable, its SHA256 must equal e07e6da8331d6d40b9f68663899739c75d20f13c8379d685960b74b418c621ba, otherwise the campaign stops and reports a blocker
environment.fixture: docs/performance-review/2026-11-04-v1.2.7-release/seed_fixture.py; every stack must report threads=201 messages=8625 content_chars=20177069 focus=8625 and complete=True
environment.quotas: platform defaults, not relaxed: max_databases=8, max_sessions=16, max_concurrent=100, requests_per_second=500, max_sql_bytes=65536, max_result_bytes=4194304
environment.durability: audit_file_v1, read from each leg's metrics
environment.observer: none (no PERI_DURABILITY_OBSERVER and no phase observer on any leg)
environment.network: docker --network host, localhost only, no TLS, one dedicated stack per leg

arms.A: same platform binary with PERI_DEFERRED_SESSION_CLOSE=0 explicitly set in the container and platform process environment (synchronous close)
arms.B: same platform binary with PERI_DEFERRED_SESSION_CLOSE completely unset in the container and platform process environment (deferred close default)

design.balance: 4 pairs A-first and 4 pairs B-first; every pair contains exactly one A leg and one B leg; 8 A legs and 8 B legs in total
design.ports: 21500-21515 in leg_sequence order, one dedicated host port per leg
design.volumes: one fresh volume per leg, all named with the prefix peri-r72b-l1-; no previous round's volume is reused, modified or deleted
design.containers: one dedicated container per leg named with the prefix peri-r72b-l1-; removed after evidence collection; the production container peri-loom and all unrelated containers are untouched
design.workload: L1.list-20 json-pipeline, c1 (single connection), exactly the R72 L1 scenario and request shape
design.harness_command: python3 scripts/perf-reliability/issue28/run.py --connection-file <private conn> --out <leg>/harness --container <leg container> --scenario L1 --protocol json-pipeline --rounds 1 --warmup 1 --samples 500
design.runner: the unmodified R72 run_p2.sh, invoked with scenario l1, SAMPLES=500, BASE_PORT=21500, PREFIX=peri-r72b-l1, OUT=<this directory>; the script is read-only and is not edited
design.leg_evidence: leg.txt, binaries.txt, seed.txt, metrics-before.json, metrics-after.json, settle.json, audit-count-before/after.txt, driver.txt, container.txt, exit-code.json, settle-exit-code.json, stop-exit.txt, launcher-stop.json, audit/, harness/raw.jsonl, harness/summary.json

primary_criterion.name: L1 c1 p95 non-inferiority
primary_criterion.metric: per-pair ratio r_i = p95(B_i) / p95(A_i) using the two legs of pair i; primary statistic = median(r_1 ... r_8)
primary_criterion.p95_definition: sort the 500 timed duration_ms values ascending and take index min(n-1, int(n * 95 / 100)) (same definition as the R72 analyze_p2.py and the Issue 28 harness); n=500 gives index 475
primary_criterion.aggregation_floor: the median is over the 8 valid pairs; a pair made invalid by an environment anomaly is replaced at most once under the replacement rule below, and both the void and the replacement are listed in the report

auxiliary_criterion.name: L1 c1 p50 non-inferiority
auxiliary_criterion.metric: per-pair ratio p50(B_i) / p50(A_i); p50 is statistics.median over the 500 timed durations; auxiliary statistic = median over the 8 valid pairs
auxiliary_criterion.role: auxiliary; the overall campaign verdict requires both the primary and the auxiliary criterion to pass

verdict_rules.PASS: primary p95 median < 1.10 AND auxiliary p50 median < 1.10 AND all 16 legs are valid AND all invariant checks below pass
verdict_rules.FAIL: primary p95 median >= 1.10; or the auxiliary p50 median >= 1.10; or any leg/invariant failure that is not an isolated environment anomaly resolved by the single allowed replacement
verdict_rules.ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED: the platform binary, worker, image, fixture or Docker runtime cannot satisfy the frozen environment, or a measurement cannot be completed; the report states exactly what was verified and what was not
verdict_rules.no_post_hoc_changes: a single leg outlier, a direction change between halves, or a wide confidence interval never changes the frozen decision rule; it is reported as context only

leg_validity.request_success: every timed sample has status == 200, outcome == ok and empty error_code; zero request failures
leg_validity.driver: driver exit code 0; harness fatal empty; harness warnings empty
leg_validity.settle: settle exit code 0 and settle.json verdict == settled
leg_validity.stop: docker stop exit code 0; launcher-stop.json outcome == clean and unresolved_operations == false
leg_validity.fixture: seed fixture PASS with threads=201 messages=8625 content_chars=20177069 focus=8625
leg_validity.response_shape: modal (response_bytes, rows, rows_read, rows_written, affected_row_count) over the 500 timed samples equals (15627, 40, 201, 0, 0); every timed sample has rows=40 and rows_read=201; the small response_bytes spread caused by the embedded query_duration_ms digit width is allowed only if the mode is exactly 15627
leg_validity.audit: verify_audit.py chain_ok true with a positive audit count delta
leg_validity.accounting: metrics-after session_seats == 0, active_permits == 0, unknown_held_permits == 0, all worker session counts == 0, all worker pending_close counts == 0, cleanup_ledger.pending_close.count == 0, errors_total delta empty
leg_validity.arm_mechanism: A legs publish no deferred_session_close key in metrics-after; B legs publish it with enqueued_total > 0, failed_total == 0, retried_total == 0, unresolved_total == 0, pending == 0 and pending_max <= 4

environment_anomaly_and_replacement.definition: stack start failure, fixture seed failure or mismatch, port or Docker runtime failure, evidence collection failure, or a leg invalid for a reason independent of the A/B treatment (for example an unreadable harness or audit file). A slow leg, a tail outlier, or a direction change is NOT an environment anomaly.
environment_anomaly_and_replacement.procedure: void the whole affected pair, record the reason and the voided evidence path, and run exactly one replacement pair with new fresh volumes named peri-r72b-l1-repl-* on ports 21516-21517. The replacement pair uses the same arm order as the pair it replaces.
environment_anomaly_and_replacement.limit: at most one replacement pair in the entire campaign; a second environment anomaly is reported as ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED, not patched by more replacements
environment_anomaly_and_replacement.reporting: the report lists the voided pair, its reason, the replacement pair and all replacement numbers

reported_not_gating.per_pair: p95 and p50 ratios for every pair
reported_not_gating.halves: median p95/p50 ratio over the first 4 pairs and over the last 4 pairs
reported_not_gating.pooled: p95 and p50 computed by pooling all 8 x 500 = 4000 timed samples per side
reported_not_gating.bootstrap: optional percentile bootstrap over the 8 per-pair ratios and over the 4000 pooled samples per side, fixed seed 20261105, 10000 draws; context only
reported_not_gating.timing: per-leg p50/p95/p99 in ms, sample counts and error counts

excluded_claims: No capacity or SLA claim is made from this campaign.
No claim of complete crash-durability coverage; R72b only measures the L1 c1 latency distribution.
No other R72 criterion is re-litigated here; the R72 results for C1/C2/C3/C5/C6/C7/C8 stand as published.
